title: ChainHealthPal
tagline: An AI mental health monitoring platform that provides timely support and resources.
description:
To build a privacy-preserving Web3 AI mental health monitoring platform that analyzes behavioral patterns such as speech, text activity, sleep, and physical movement to detect early signs of anxiety or depression and provide timely support and resources.

ChainHealthPal  continuously analyzes behavioral signals such as communication style, sleep patterns, and activity levels using machine learning models.

The platform detects subtle behavioral changes that may signal mental health risks and provides early alerts, insights, and self-care recommendations, while securely storing sensitive health insights on blockchain infrastructure to ensure privacy, ownership, and transparency.

Users remain in full control of their data, and the platform can optionally connect them with mental health professionals or support networks when risk levels increase.
how_its_made: The ChainHealthPal platform continuously gathers behavioral signals like speech patterns, text Messages, sleep patterns and activity Levels. The platform integrates technologies from smartphone sensors, wearables, messaging interactions, and voice recordings. Sensitive data is encrypted before storage. AI and machine learning models analyze behavioral data to identify patterns such as reduced communication frequency, negative language sentiment, sleep disruption, reduced physical activity, and speech tone changes to compare new data with baseline user behavior in order to detect mental health deviations. The platform provides feedback for unusual patterns. The platform recommends self-help tools and professional support.
